column1: # How the catalog's chat models fare as Claude Code's model (the Code page, claude-bedrock and the browser terminal).
# Claude Code speaks Anthropic's Messages API with tools; LiteLLM translates /v1/messages for every other provider, but
# tool use, thinking, prompt caching and long contexts vary. lib/code_models.sh reads this file (first matching row
# wins; a pattern is a model name, an "or/<OpenRouter id>", or a prefix ending in *) and ./stack writes the result to
# litellm/code-models.tsv for the portal, claude-bedrock and LiteLLM (litellm/bn_hooks.py).
#   status   works (a Claude Code turn with a tool call round-trips) | chat-only (answers, but cannot use tools: Claude
#            Code cannot read, edit or run anything) | fails (a session errors) | untested
#   max_out  the most output tokens the provider accepts in one answer, or -: Claude Code asks for up to 32,000 and some
#            providers refuse more than their limit, so LiteLLM lowers a larger request to this (litellm/bn_hooks.py)
#   note     shown in the Code page's picker, claude-bedrock --models and the terminal's /model menu
# Not listed here: OpenRouter models are "untested" when OpenRouter lists tool use for them (supported_parameters),
# "chat-only" when it does not; any other model is "untested".
# Checked 2026-10-17 with Claude Code 2.1.296 through LiteLLM 1.105.0 (one short claude -p turn that must run a shell
# command, with the full system prompt and tools and with a minimal one): Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and Mistral round-trip
# the tool call; Llama 3.3 70B needed the output cap (Bedrock refuses more than 8,192) and then wrote its tool call as
# plain text. Amazon Nova Micro (not in the catalog) works too once capped at 10,000.
# pattern
claude-*
column4: Anthropic's own: tools, thinking and prompt caching as Claude Code expects.

column1: gpt-6-*
column4: Tools work through LiteLLM's translation; no thinking blocks, prompt caching as OpenAI does it.

column1: grok-4-7
column4: Tools work through LiteLLM's translation; no thinking blocks, no prompt-cache writes.

column1: mistral-large-3
column4: Tools work through LiteLLM's translation; no thinking blocks, no prompt caching.

column1: llama-3-3-70b
column4: Answers, but writes its tool calls as plain text: Claude Code cannot read, edit or run anything with it.
